registration: prospective analysis for a new training trajectory and a separately sealed fresh panel; not an analysis of intermediate states from v0.8N

metric_implementation.use: unchanged neighborhood metric definitions and candidate-semantic-ID alignment

inference_implementation_reference.use: reference only; P evaluator must bind its exact source hash before evaluation authorization

parents_and_bindings.E1_exclusion: No E1 neighborhood, target, feature cache, candidate join, prediction, or metric is a P evaluation input. O is cited only as the sealed prior study motivating the P question.

checkpoint_cells.initialization_label: COMMON_INIT; one shared template evaluated once per seed, not duplicated as three arm outcomes

evaluation_design.inference_order: seed ascending; common initialization once per seed; then global steps ascending within each seed and arm; fixed arm ordering B-DUP, B-MATCHED, B-SHAM; neighborhoods in lexical neighborhood_id order

neighborhood_capability_vector.implementation: Call unchanged neighborhood_metrics from analyze_phase_b_v01.py; no metric-definition or tie-break change.
neighborhood_capability_vector.aggregation: Report each metric separately by seed, arm, global optimizer step, and each of four families; overall aggregates retain the equal 500-neighborhood family allocation. No composite score.

transition_decomposition.report: Counts and proportions per seed, arm, global step, overall and separately by family.
transition_decomposition.partition_invariant: The four counts sum to 2,000 for each cell and 500 within each family.

primary_longitudinal_estimands.question: Where within global optimizer steps 81-120 do the separate capability coordinates change on fresh held-out neighborhoods, and does treatment alter their timing or form?
primary_longitudinal_estimands.paired_unit: same fresh neighborhood_id across arms and checkpoints within a seed
primary_longitudinal_estimands.primary_arm_contrast: B-SHAM minus B-MATCHED trajectories, displayed per seed and step
primary_longitudinal_estimands.claim_unit: which auxiliary examples trained the frozen-substrate decision head; not capability change in the frozen backbone

descriptive_event_time_rules.scope: Timing descriptors, not pass criteria, winner scores, or checkpoint-promotion rules.
descriptive_event_time_rules.reference_point: epoch-2 terminal at global_step=80 on the same fresh held-out neighborhoods

bootstrap.resampling_unit: whole neighborhood trajectory; all four views and all measured checkpoint steps move together
bootstrap.stratification: resample 500 neighborhoods with replacement independently within each of the four families
bootstrap.seed_derivation: SHA-256(UTF-8('jev-information-density-v08p-analysis-v01/bootstrap')); first four bytes unsigned little-endian u32
bootstrap.simultaneity: one-sided 95% max-deviation bootstrap band across the 40 epoch-3 steps for each seed-arm-coordinate series
bootstrap.band_formula: For each time k, let d_hat[k] be the observed mean change from step 80 and d_b[k] the same change in bootstrap replicate b. Set e_b[k]=d_b[k]-d_hat[k]. The lower band is d_hat[k]-Q95(max_k(-e_b[k])); the upper band is d_hat[k]+Q95(max_k(e_b[k])). Use the lower band for positive onsets and upper band for negative onsets.
bootstrap.seed_scope: conditional neighborhood uncertainty for one trained seed; no pooled optimizer-seed inference

descriptive_event_time_rules.persistence: A continuous-coordinate onset requires the relevant one-sided simultaneous band to remain beyond zero for three consecutive optimizer-step checkpoints.
descriptive_event_time_rules.fact_probability_movement_rise: First step where the lower simultaneous band for new_probability_delta minus its step-80 value is above zero for three consecutive steps.
descriptive_event_time_rules.anchor_loss: First step where the upper simultaneous band for anchor_old_map minus its step-80 value is below zero for three consecutive steps.
descriptive_event_time_rules.sham_locality_change: Report separately the first sustained decrease and first sustained increase in sham_l1 relative to step 80, using the corresponding simultaneous band; do not assume a direction.
descriptive_event_time_rules.matched_locality_change: Apply the same separate decrease/increase rule to matched_l1.
descriptive_event_time_rules.fact_new_map_appearance: Report first step with at least one neighborhood at fact_new_map=1 and first three-consecutive-step run with a nonzero rate; if already nonzero at step 80, mark PRESENT_AT_BASELINE. Always include event counts, so one case is not mistaken for broad acquisition.
descriptive_event_time_rules.strict_transition_appearance: Report first nonzero and first three-consecutive-step nonzero strict_transition rate, with counts; descriptive only.
descriptive_event_time_rules.censoring: If no defined event occurs by global_step=120, report NOT_OBSERVED_BY_STEP_120; do not extrapolate.
descriptive_event_time_rules.legacy_v08n_0_37_floor: Not a P success, failure, authorization, or checkpoint rule. Do not use the old terminal floor to classify P trajectories.
descriptive_event_time_rules.family_scope: Show family trajectories at every step. Family-specific event times are descriptive only and do not receive confirmatory labels or multiplicity-adjusted claims.

uncertainty_and_seed_heterogeneity.neighborhood_bootstrap: 10,000 stratified cluster resamples as specified above; intervals are conditional on the fixed seed trajectory and fresh panel.
uncertainty_and_seed_heterogeneity.seed_reporting: Show all three complete trajectories and event times individually; three seeds are three trajectories, not a population estimate.
uncertainty_and_seed_heterogeneity.seed_summary: A mean or median across the three trajectories may be shown descriptively alongside every individual value; no population CI, population p-value, or universal mechanism claim.
uncertainty_and_seed_heterogeneity.family_reporting: All four families remain visible; no outcome-driven exclusions, subgrouping, or reweighting.
uncertainty_and_seed_heterogeneity.multiplicity: No confirmatory p-values across the many trajectory coordinates or steps. Simultaneous bands are used only for the predeclared descriptive onset rules within each series.

parameter_path.initial_reference: new shared per-seed P initialization template
parameter_path.global_displacement: float64 L2 norm of concatenated state_dict deltas from that seed's initial template at every sealed checkpoint
parameter_path.per_tensor_displacement: float64 L2 norm for each exact state_dict tensor key; no regrouping or dropping
parameter_path.paired_update_cosines: cosines among DUP/MATCHED/SHAM update vectors from the same seed initialization at each saved checkpoint
parameter_path.role: descriptive only; do not infer mechanism, basin identity, or causal mediation from parameter-space geometry

interpretation_limits.fresh_panel_scope: Fresh generated world instances within the four held-out semantic families and frozen p0-p3 template surfaces; not a new-template generalization claim.
interpretation_limits.intermediate_checkpoint: No intermediate checkpoint is a validated operating point, promoted model, or duration recommendation.
interpretation_limits.timing_claim: P locates coordinate changes on a new training trajectory at saved optimizer-step resolution; it does not insert states into or reinterpret the sealed v0.8N/O trajectories.
interpretation_limits.trajectory_claim: Results characterize these three new paired seeds; seed-specific paths must remain visible.
interpretation_limits.mechanism_claim: No claim that semantic identity, representation direction, higher-order geometry, or a particular optimizer mechanism caused the observed timing.
